title: Solar Flare
description: A solar flare event from NASA's DONKI space weather database.

flrID.description: Unique identifier for the solar flare event.

beginTime.description: Start time of the solar flare.

peakTime.description: Peak time of the solar flare.

endTime.description: End time of the solar flare.

classType.description: Classification of the flare (e.g. X, M, C, B, A).

sourceLocation.description: Location on the Sun where the flare originated.

activeRegionNum.description: Active region number on the Sun.
